d:
Bihar men 125 yunit mupht bijli yojna ko lekar naee bahas chhir gaee hai. sarkar ki apil hai ki saksham upbhokta svechchha se mupht bijli ka labh chhoren, lekin saval hai ki aakhir bihar men kaun khud ko itna saksham mankar yah suvidha chhorega? is Explainer men samjhie yojna, sarkar ki apil aur iske pichhe ki puri rajniti.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
